    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Argument<T>
    Provides a way to define a specific argument in a collection of arguments, including a way to parse its value and documentation of what it is used for.
    Argument.Flag
    A flag is a key argument (a string starting with a dash) that is either present or not in a collection of arguments and does not have a value after it.
    Argument.Index<T>
    An index is an Argument at a specific position in a collection of arguments.
    Argument.Integer
    A Argument.Parser that converts a string to an integer in a defined range.
    Argument.Key<T>
    A key is an Argument that starts with a dash and is followed by a value.
    Argument.Parsed<T>
    A parsed Argument is associated in some way with a string value that can be converted into another kind of object via a Argument.Parser.
    Argument.Parser<T>
    A parser is a function which converts a string value from a collection of arguments into an object of a certain type.
    Arguments
    A wrapper for the string arguments passed to a Java program's main method that provides ways to check which arguments exist, what their values are, and which have been used.
    BigHashMap<K,V>
    A map based on a hash table, which uses a hash function to map keys to an array of values.
    BigHashSet<T>
    A BigSet backed by a BigHashMap.
    BigMap<K,V>
    A custom implementation of a map, which associates unique keys with values, which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY entries, and which uses long integers to measure its BigMap.size().
    BigNumberedMap<K,V>
    A map that uses numbered story graph elements as keys and stores values in an array list indexed by the key's ID number.
    BigNumberedSet<N>
    A set of numbered story graph elements.
    BigQueue<T>
    A custom implementation of a first-in first-out queue which can hold up to Long.MAX_VALUE elements and which uses long integers to measure its BigQueue.size().
    BigSet<T>
    A custom implementation of a collection that does not allow duplicates which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY elements and which uses long integers to measure its BigSet.size().
    BreadthFirstSearch
    A task that performs a breadth-first search of a story graph, starting at node 0, and labeling each node based on the order in which it was visited by the search.
    CleanTool
    A story graph tool that provides an convenient interface to the combined RemoveDisconnected, RemoveUnused, RemoveDuplicates, and Sort tasks.
    Entry<K,V>
    An individual key/value pair in a map.
    Explain
    A task that discovers new explanations in a story graph.
    ExplainTool
    A story graph tool that provides an interface to the Explain task.
    ExplanationSet
    A wrapper around a story graph that makes it possible to add explanations only if an equivalent explanation does not already exist.
    ExploreTool
    A story graph tool that that prints a human-readable description of a story graph node to standard output and accepts directions from standard input that allow the user to visit other nodes and explore a story graph.
    NewExplanationSet
    Tracks a set of explanations in a story graph and provides a way to add explanations to this set without creating duplicates in the story graph.
    NodeHashMap<V>
    A hash map that uses nodes as keys, where two nodes are considered the same if they have the same value for every fluent, the same utility for every character, and for each character the beliefs of that character lead to nodes which are the same.
    RemoveDisconnected
    A task that removes all nodes from a story graph that cannot be reached via a path of temporal or epistemic edges from node 0.
    RemoveDisconnectedTool
    A story graph tool that provides an interface to the RemoveDisconnected task.
    RemoveDuplicateNodes
    A task that replaces duplicate nodes in a story graph.
    RemoveDuplicatePlans
    A task that removes duplicate plans from a story graph's list of StoryGraph.plans.
    RemoveDuplicates
    A task that replaces duplicate elements in a story graph to save memory.
    RemoveDuplicateStates
    A task that removes duplicate states from a story graph's list of StoryGraph.states.
    RemoveDuplicatesTool
    A story graph tool that provides an interface to the RemoveDuplicates task.
    RemoveUnexplained
    A task that removes the temporal edges from a story graph if the action is not explained for its consenting characters.
    RemoveUnexplainedTool
    A story graph tool that provides an interface to the RemoveUnexplained task.
    RemoveUnused
    A task that removes unused elements from a story graph.
    RemoveUnusedTool
    A story graph tool that provides an interface to the RemoveUnused task.
    SequenceHashMap<V>
    A hash map that uses action sequences as keys, where two sequences are considered the same if they represent the same actions in the same order.
    SimpleStoryGraphTool
    A parent class for a story graph tool that reads a story graph from file, performs an operation on it, and writes the resulting graph to file.
    Sort
    A task that sorts the various elements of a story graph.
    SortEdges
    A task that sorts the edges of a story graph in ascending order based on the ID numbers of their tail nodes and then the ID numbers of their labels.
    SortExplanations
    A task that sorts the explanations in a story graph ascending based on the ID number of the node they are associated with, the character forming the plan, and the plan being formed.
    SortNodes
    A task that sorts the nodes of a story graph based on the order they were visited during a breadth-first search starting at node 0.
    SortPlans
    A task that sorts the plans in a story graph to maximize the chances that a a tail plan will be created to save memory when reading the story graph's plans.
    SortStates
    A task that sorts the states of a story graph ascending based on the ID number of the first node that uses the state.
    SortSymbols
    A task that sorts a list of story graph symbols alphabetically by name.
    SortTool
    A story graph tool that provides an interface to the Sort task.
    StateHashMap<V>
    A hash map that uses states as keys, where two states are considered the same if they return the same values for all fluents and return the same utility values for the author and all characters.
    StoryGraphChange
    Represents a story graph before and after some operation.
    StoryGraphSummary
    A collection of numeric statistics about the sizes of collections in a story graph, such as the number of characters, number of nodes, etc.
    StoryGraphTool
    A parent class for story graph tools which provides meta-data and methods for automatically generating documentation.
    TailSequence
    A sequence of actions made by adding an action to the beginning of another sequence.
    UnusedElementSearch
    A breadth-first search task that marks story graph elements used as they are encountered, allowing any unused elements to be identified.
